pieces.title: Every contradiction in the palace
pieces.caption: All sixty-one pairs the map holds in contradiction, face to face, both kept. The pairs of people and traditions are the ones ready to be put in a room. *What is real and what is a choice:* Every 'contradicts' link between two pages, each declared by one side only. Here the word means a tension worth keeping, not that either page calls the other wrong. *Leaking in:* Palace Philosophies: 'Contradictions are dispatchable as Dialectics.'

verdicts.file: Dialectic — rich — every contradiction in the palace.png
verdicts.why: The in-image subhead "61 pairs of pages that say the other is wrong" is false twice: no pair is mutual (one page declares each link), and the palace's own reading of `contradicts` is "productive tension", keep both true. "Any pair can be put in a room" overreaches the page, which says voices are thinkers, practitioners or traditions and lists a non-human voice as "still untried"; the 61 include Registry Pattern ≠ Lateral Access, LDN RTM ≠ Progressive Staging, Andy Goldsworthy ≠ OBS, Songlines ≠ Kokoro.
